summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: US futures attempt a modest recovery after Thursday's decline, with S&P 500 futures up 0.42% and Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.20% versus the previous cash close. October PPI rose 0.3% month over month and 6.5% year over year; the measure excluding food, energy and trade services rose 0.5%. Treasury yields remain elevated as next week's AI catalysts approach.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：周四美股下跌后，标普500和纳斯达克100期货较前一现金收盘分别上涨0.42%和0.20%，呈现温和修复。10月PPI环比上涨0.3%、同比上涨6.5%；剔除食品、能源和贸易服务的指标环比上涨0.5%。美债收益率仍处高位，下周AI相关重要事件临近。

title.en: October PPI rises 0.3% month over month and 6.5% year over year
title.zh: 美国10月PPI环比上涨0.3%、同比上涨6.5%

impact.en: The BLS release published at 08:30 EST reports a 0.3% increase in final-demand PPI. Goods prices rose 0.5% and services 0.2%. Excluding food, energy and trade services, prices rose 0.5% monthly and 4.9% annually. The headline monthly pace slowed from September's revised 1.4%, while broad underlying price pressure persisted.
impact.zh: 美国劳工统计局08:30 EST公布，最终需求PPI环比上涨0.3%，其中商品价格上涨0.5%、服务价格上涨0.2%；剔除食品、能源和贸易服务后，环比上涨0.5%、同比上涨4.9%。整体月度涨幅较9月修正后的1.4%放缓，但更广泛的基础价格压力仍然存在。

bullish: 整体月度涨幅放缓，可能缓和部分通胀担忧 / Slower headline monthly growth may ease some inflation concerns.
bearish: 基础价格压力仍强，政策约束可能延续 / Persistent underlying price pressure may sustain policy constraints.

macroRisk.en: PPI measures producer prices and is distinct from CPI and PCE. One monthly release does not establish a disinflation trend or determine the next Federal Reserve decision.
macroRisk.zh: PPI衡量生产者价格，与CPI和PCE的口径不同；单月数据不能确立通胀放缓趋势，也不能单独决定美联储下一次行动。

title.en: Nvidia results and Anthropic's expected listing set up next week's AI tests
title.zh: 英伟达财报与Anthropic拟上市构成下周AI板块的重要考验

impact.en: Reuters identifies Nvidia's Tuesday results under interim CEO Colette Kress and Anthropic's expected trading debut two days later as separate catalysts. It reports an offering valuation of up to $1.4T for Anthropic. These are forthcoming events and expectations; neither Nvidia's actual results nor Anthropic's trading performance is known at this cutoff.
impact.zh: 路透社将英伟达在临时CEO Colette Kress领导下于周二公布的财报，以及两天后Anthropic预计开始交易，列为两项独立催化剂；报道提及Anthropic发行估值最高可达$1.4T。上述属于未来安排与预期，在本信息截点尚无英伟达实际业绩或Anthropic上市交易表现。

bullish: 财报与新股定价将提供新的需求观察线索 / Results and IPO pricing may add evidence on AI demand.
bearish: 管理层交接与估值预期带来事件风险 / Leadership transition and valuation expectations create event risk.

macroRisk.en: Concentrated AI exposure can amplify index volatility if results or demand expectations disappoint. A proposed IPO valuation is not a completed market capitalization.
macroRisk.zh: 若业绩或需求预期不及预期，集中的AI敞口可能放大指数波动；拟议IPO估值也不等于已完成交易形成的市值。

title.en: Futures recover modestly after Thursday's decline; recent policy commentary reviewed
title.zh: 周四下跌后期货温和修复，盘前综述回顾近期政策表态

impact.en: MT Newswires' 07:46 EST overview describes firmer futures following Thursday's cash-market decline. It reviews Thursday remarks from Goolsbee, Hammack and Daly, reflecting differing views on the pace of further tightening. Its 08:30 PPI schedule has now passed; today's actual release is covered separately above.
impact.zh: MT Newswires在07:46 EST的盘前综述中记录了周四现金市场下跌后的期货回升，并回顾古尔斯比、哈马克和戴利周四的讲话，显示对进一步收紧步伐的看法有所差异。该综述所列08:30 PPI发布时间在当前截点已经过去，实际数据单列于上方。

bullish: 期货回升显示修复意愿 / Firmer futures suggest an attempted recovery.
bearish: 持续的通胀约束可能限制估值修复 / Ongoing inflation constraints may limit valuation recovery.

macroRisk.en: Official commentary is not a new FOMC rate decision. Premarket futures direction does not guarantee cash-market follow-through.
macroRisk.zh: 官员评论不等于新的FOMC利率决议；盘前期货方向也不能保证现金市场开盘后的延续性。

keyRisk.en: Watch whether the futures recovery broadens into cash technology and semiconductor shares while Treasury yields remain high. Distinguish the released PPI data from earlier forecasts and next week's AI-event expectations.
keyRisk.zh: 关注美债收益率维持高位时，期货修复能否扩散至科技和半导体现货股票；区分已公布的PPI实际数据、此前预测，以及下周AI事件的预期。

note.en: I lean toward a tentative recovery with continuing rate sensitivity. S&P 500 futures are up 0.42% and Nasdaq-100 futures 0.20% after Thursday's declines, while the 10-year yield has risen 2.6 basis points to 5.129%. The dollar is nearly flat at +0.02%, and Brent is up 0.93%, giving the rebound a mixed cross-asset backdrop. October's 0.3% headline PPI increase offers some moderation, but the 0.5% increase excluding food, energy and trade services limits confidence in rapid inflation relief. Watch cash-market breadth and semiconductor participation: broader gains with easing yield pressure would support the recovery; narrowing participation or further yield increases would weaken it.
note.zh: 我倾向于将盘前表现解读为试探性修复，利率敏感性仍高。周四下跌后，标普500和纳指100期货分别上涨0.42%和0.20%，但10年期收益率上升2.6个基点至5.129%。美元指数仅上涨0.02%、基本持平，布伦特原油上涨0.93%，跨资产背景仍有分歧。10月整体PPI环比上涨0.3%体现一定缓和，但剔除食品、能源和贸易服务后上涨0.5%，限制了对通胀迅速减轻的信心。关注现金市场广度和半导体参与度：若涨势扩散且利率压力缓解，将支持修复；若参与度收窄或收益率进一步上行，则会削弱这一判断。
